title: An echo in a call archive

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: On yesterday’s training recording, every sentence from the trainer repeats half a beat later. Nobody on the call reported an echo, though.
turns.zh: 昨天的培訓錄音裡，講師每句話過半拍就重複一遍，但通話時沒有人反映有回音。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Play the two tracks separately. The meeting track should contain the trainer. The room track is for the questions from people sitting with you.
turns.zh: 把兩條音軌分開播放。會議音軌應該收錄講師，現場音軌則是錄跟你坐在一起的人提問。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Separately, each track sounds clear. But the room microphone picked up our loudspeaker. I need the questions in the archive, not just the trainer.
turns.zh: 分開聽兩軌都很清楚。不過現場麥克風錄到了我們的擴音喇叭。我需要把提問也存檔，不只保留講師的聲音。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Keep the meeting track running. Use the room track only for questions, not for the trainer’s answers.
turns.zh: 保留會議音軌全程播放。現場音軌只在提問時使用，不要用在講師回答的部分。
